# HardRevival

> HardRevival is a German Minecraft hardcore PvP server. Players fight for
> survival with permadeath-style stakes, a rare "Life Saver" item, death
> structures that drop the victim's head as a trophy, and a revival ritual
> that can bring fallen players back.

HardRevival is built around high-stakes PvP: every encounter can be your last,
a Life Saver item can be consumed instead of your final life, and when a player
dies without one a macabre structure is left behind holding their head.
Survivors can use a fallen player's head to perform a revival ritual and bring
teammates back. The site publishes live leaderboards and per-player statistics,
plus the server rules. The project is run by NeoFoxi.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://hardrevival.net/): Server overview, game features, FAQ and community status.
- [Leaderboard](https://hardrevival.net/leaderboard/): Global ranking by kills, revivals and deaths.
- [Statistics](https://hardrevival.net/statistics/): Per-player kill, revive and death details.
- [Rules](https://hardrevival.net/rules/): Official server rulebook — eleven sections covering fair play, PvP, chat, recordings, privacy and penalties.
- [Rules (PDF)](https://hardrevival.net/rules.pdf): The same rulebook as a downloadable PDF.
